name: 进阶模板-猛犸坦克
data:
#进阶模板
[core]
name: mammoth_tank_Template

#直接调用原版猛犸坦克描述 请和下方多语言任选一个 去注释即可使用

#displayLocaleKey: mammothTank

#多语言
displayText: mammoth_tank(Template)
displayDescription: -The mighty Mammoth tank can only hit the ground, causing lightning attacks that can break shields.

#若取消下行注释则替换游戏内部猛犸坦克
#overrideAndReplace: mammothTank

class: CustomUnitMetadata
#price: 4200
price: 3900

#maxHp: 3200
maxHp: 2600

mass: 14000

experimental: true

techLevel: 2
buildSpeed: 0.0006
#availableInDemo: true

radius: 22
displayRadius: 20

isBio: false
softCollisionOnAll: 0


builtFrom_1_name: landFactory
builtFrom_1_pos:  8.1


[graphics]
total_frames: 3

image:        CORE:/mammoth_tank/mammoth_tank.png
image_wreak:  CORE:/mammoth_tank/mammoth_tank_dead.png
image_turret: CORE:/mammoth_tank/mammoth_tank_turret.png

image_shadow: AUTO
shadowOffsetX:2
shadowOffsetY:2


animation_moving_start: 0
animation_moving_end: 2
animation_moving_speed: 2.85


dustEffect: true

[attack]
canAttack: true
canAttackFlyingUnits: false
canAttackLandUnits:   true
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false

turretSize: 20
turretTurnSpeed: 4

maxAttackRange: 190

#shootDelay:140 #original
shootDelay: 50

[turret_1]
#coil
x: 0
y: 0
attachedTo: 2
slave: true

projectile: 1

turnSpeed: 0
turnSpeedAcceleration: 0

shoot_sound:lighting_burst
shoot_sound_vol:0.3
shoot_flame:CUSTOM:sparks2*3
shoot_light:#FFcceeee

canShoot: true

warmup:30

image: CORE:/mammoth_tank/mammoth_tank_coil.png

chargeEffectImage: SHARED:lighting_charge.png

recoilOffset: -1.5
recoilOutTime: 3
recoilReturnTime: 17


[turret_2]
#turret
x: 0
y: 0

canShoot: false

turnSpeed: 2.5
turnSpeedAcceleration: 0.18
turnSpeedDeceleration: 0.35

recoilOffset: -0.75
recoilOutTime: 3
recoilReturnTime: 17

[projectile_1]
#directDamage: 310
directDamage: 130

life: 25
#瞬间命中
instant: true
#闪电效果
lightingEffect: true
largeHitEffect: true

#对于护盾是满伤，也就是直接绕过护盾
shieldDamageMultiplier: 1

shieldDefectionMultiplier: 0.1

#对于建筑单位则只有1/2的伤害
buildingDamageMultiplier: 0.5

#抛射体爆炸效果
explodeEffect:CUSTOM:lightningShock, CUSTOM:sparks*8

#抛射体在护盾上的爆炸效果
explodeEffectOnShield:CUSTOM:lightningShock*1, CUSTOM:hitLightFlash

#效果组
[effect_hitLightFlash]
priority:high

image: SHARED:light_50.png
life: 17
fadeOut: true
attachedToUnit: false
color: #63e6e8

scaleFrom: 1.8
scaleTo: 1.8
alpha: 0.6
drawUnderUnits:false


[effect_lightningShock]
life: 60


hOffset: 0
dirOffset: 0

fadeInTime: 0
fadeOut: false

attachedToUnit: true


image: SHARED:lightning_shock.png
total_frames: 14
animateFrameStart: 0
animateFrameEnd: 13
animateFramePingPong: false
animateFrameSpeed: 0.5


[effect_sparks]
attachedToUnit: false
life: 150
physics: true
xSpeedRelativeRandom: 1.6
ySpeedRelativeRandom: 1.6
hSpeed: 2
image: SHARED:spark.png
priority: verylow

[effect_sparks2]
attachedToUnit: false
life: 150
physics: true
xSpeedRelativeRandom: 0.5
ySpeedRelativeRandom: 0.5
hSpeed: 1
image: SHARED:spark.png
priority: verylow

[movement]
movementType: LAND
moveSpeed: 0.6
moveAccelerationSpeed: 0.04
moveDecelerationSpeed: 0.06

reverseSpeedPercentage:1.0

maxTurnSpeed: 1.4
turnAcceleration: 0.15

moveSlidingMode :false
moveIgnoringBody:false
